hunks.baseline: I woke with a dull headache and looked around. I was in an unfamiliar place—a spacious, clean hotel room.
hunks.sol: I woke with a dull headache and looked around. I was in an unfamiliar place—a spacious, spotless hotel room.

hunks.baseline: Only then did the memories of last night gradually come back to me.
hunks.sol: Only then did the memories of last night come flooding back.

hunks.baseline: *Right. We went to a hotel for the second round and had a champagne party.*
hunks.sol: *Right. We came to a hotel for the second round and had a champagne party.*

hunks.baseline: Good God, a champagne party at a hotel.
hunks.sol: Good God. A champagne party at a hotel.

hunks.baseline: Put that way, it made me feel like I had become the third-generation heir to some chaebol family. Though, come to think of it, Team Leader Choi might actually be one.
hunks.sol: Put that way, I sounded like the third-generation heir to some chaebol family. Then again, Team Leader Choi might actually be one.

hunks.baseline: What kind of snore sounded like someone shouting? Hyung Jinho snored pretty loudly too, but next to this guy, it was practically on mute.
hunks.sol: What kind of snoring sounded like someone shouting? Jinho hyung was a champion snorer himself, but next to this guy, he might as well have been on mute.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I thought it was a hotel employee coming to inform us of our forced eviction. But it wasn’t. A clear, refreshing voice came from the other side of the door.
hunks.sol: For a moment, I thought a hotel employee had come to inform us that we were being thrown out. But no. A clear, bright voice came from the other side of the door.

hunks.baseline: I dashed to the door at the speed of light. Before opening it, I didn’t forget to spray on some of the perfume provided in the room and check my clothes.
hunks.sol: I dashed to the door at the speed of light. Before opening it, I made sure to spray on some of the perfume provided in the room and straighten my clothes.

hunks.baseline: My heart pounded when I looked into Miss Song’s limpid, lake-like eyes. I somehow managed to squeeze out a trembling voice.
hunks.sol: Miss Song’s clear, lake-like eyes gazed steadily at me, setting my heart pounding. I barely managed to squeeze out a greeting in a trembling voice.

hunks.baseline: “No. I kept waking up because of the snoring.”
hunks.sol: “No. The snoring kept waking me up.”

hunks.baseline: Not a good start. I blamed Im Kkeokjeong, who was still snoring ferociously, and quickly changed the subject.
hunks.sol: Not a good start. Cursing Im Kkeokjeong, who was still snoring ferociously, I quickly changed the subject.

hunks.baseline: Miss Song looked at me as if something were wrong.
hunks.sol: Miss Song looked at me as if she couldn’t see what the problem was.

hunks.baseline: Who would’ve thought I’d live to see the day I had breakfast alone with a woman? And not just any woman—she was exactly my type. I felt as if my eyes were growing moist.
hunks.sol: Who would’ve thought I’d live to see the day I had breakfast alone with a woman? And not just any woman—one who was exactly my type. I could almost feel my eyes welling up.

hunks.baseline: *At last, an oasis has appeared in my desert of a life.*
hunks.sol: *At last, an oasis has appeared in the desert of my life.*

hunks.baseline: I wouldn’t have minded eating combat rations for breakfast if I could eat them with her. I answered with determination.
hunks.sol: I wouldn’t have minded eating combat rations for breakfast as long as I was eating them with her. I answered with determination.

hunks.baseline: The group chat we had created for the Guild last night was open on the screen.
hunks.sol: The Guild group chat we had created last night was open on the screen.

hunks.baseline: Damn it. And just when I was getting excited. That was my life for you.
hunks.sol: Damn it. And just when I was getting excited. Story of my life.

hunks.baseline: Miss Song turned away, leaving me looking dejected.
hunks.sol: Leaving me there dejected, Miss Song turned away.

hunks.baseline: I stared longingly at her retreating back as she walked away on light, graceful steps.
hunks.sol: I stared longingly after her as she walked away with light, graceful steps.

hunks.baseline: “Even her back is pretty.”
hunks.sol: “Even she looks pretty from behind.”

hunks.baseline: *Is this guy really not a former bandit?*
hunks.sol: *Was this guy seriously not a bandit before becoming a Hunter?*

hunks.baseline: I barely managed to wake Im Kkeokjeong before heading down to the first floor.
hunks.sol: After barely managing to wake Im Kkeokjeong, I headed down to the first floor with him.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi, who was sitting by the window, waved when he saw us.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was sitting by the window. He waved when he saw us.

hunks.baseline: Since it was a hotel breakfast, I had expected something like an absurdly tiny serving of pasta. But what arrived on the table was a steaming bowl of haejangguk.[^1]
hunks.sol: Since it was a hotel breakfast, I had expected something like an absurdly tiny serving of pasta. Instead, a steaming bowl of haejangguk sat on the table.[^1]

hunks.baseline: “You really know what you’re doing, Team Leader.”
hunks.sol: “You really know your stuff, Team Leader.”

hunks.baseline: I still had some of last night’s hangover left, but one bowl of haejangguk seemed like it would make circulating my qi unnecessary.
hunks.sol: I still had some of last night’s hangover left, but one bowl of haejangguk looked like it would make circulating my qi unnecessary.

hunks.baseline: His dark expression suggested that he had really wanted it.
hunks.sol: Judging by his dark expression, he must have really wanted that pasta.

hunks.baseline: Still, I never would’ve expected Miss Song to order hangover soup. Judging by her appearance, she looked like a pampered young lady from a wealthy family. But after what she had shown us yesterday, and now this, she had a surprisingly down-to-earth side.
hunks.sol: Still, I never would’ve expected Miss Song to order hangover soup. From her appearance, she looked like the sheltered young lady of some wealthy family, but between yesterday and now, she had shown a surprisingly down-to-earth side.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, this is good. What are you all doing? You should eat while the broth’s still hot.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, that hits the spot. What are you all doing? You should eat while the broth’s still hot.”

hunks.baseline: Watching Miss Song eat her haejangguk with such gusto warmed a corner of my heart. She had such a healthy appetite.
hunks.sol: Watching Miss Song dig into her haejangguk warmed a corner of my heart. Even the way she ate was delightful.

hunks.baseline: *So this is what it means when simply looking at someone fills you up.*
hunks.sol: *So this is what people mean when they say just watching someone eat fills them up.*

hunks.baseline: In a state where I could no longer tell whether the food was going into my nose or my mouth, the meal finally came to an end. While everyone except me sagged back in their seats, bloated with food, Team Leader Choi spoke.
hunks.sol: I was so distracted that I couldn’t tell whether the food was going into my nose or my mouth, but eventually the meal came to an end. While everyone except me slumped back in their seats, stuffed, Team Leader Choi spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Move where?”
hunks.sol: “Where?”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong cut in while patting his stuffed belly.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong cut in, patting his bulging belly.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, I really like makgeolli too.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, I’m very fond of makgeolli myself.”

hunks.baseline: [^2]: Makgeolli is a traditional Korean rice wine with a milky appearance and a mildly sweet, tangy flavor.
Butler Kim, who had been quietly listening to us, smiled and continued.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim, who had been quietly listening to us, smiled.

hunks.baseline: “Unfortunately, it would be better to go there for our next Guild dinner. We have something more important to take care of today.”
hunks.sol: “Unfortunately, I think we’d better save that for our next Guild dinner. We have something more important to take care of today.”

hunks.baseline: The Guild Master was Butler Kim, but he wasn’t the one who made the decisions.
hunks.sol: Butler Kim might have been the Guild Master, but someone else made the decisions.

hunks.baseline: With everyone’s eyes on him, Team Leader Choi opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: With everyone’s eyes on him, Team Leader Choi spoke.

hunks.baseline: It was the Peace Guild’s first raid.
hunks.sol: It was time for the Peace Guild’s first raid.

hunks.baseline: Humanity was thrown into shock by the Great Cataclysm.
hunks.sol: The Great Cataclysm left humanity reeling in shock.

hunks.baseline: Gates began appearing without warning one day, and unidentified creatures poured out of them.
hunks.sol: Gates appeared without warning one day, and unknown creatures came pouring out of them.

hunks.baseline: If aliens with thin limbs and oversized heads had invaded, people might have been less surprised. But these creatures hadn’t come in spaceships, and they didn’t shoot guns.
hunks.sol: People might have been less shocked if aliens with thin limbs and oversized heads had invaded instead. But these creatures hadn’t arrived in spaceships, nor did they fire guns.

hunks.baseline: With their terrible stench and eyes gleaming with killing intent, the monsters tore humans apart like sheets of paper as they swept through cities and set them ablaze.
hunks.sol: Reeking horribly, their eyes gleaming with killing intent, the monsters swept through cities, burning them and tearing humans apart like paper.

hunks.baseline: They were monsters that seemed as if they belonged in novels, movies, or myths.
hunks.sol: They were creatures that should have existed only in novels, movies, or myths.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Of course. I saw them in a Greek and Roman mythology comic when I was in elementary school. They were pretty cool—huge muscles and everything.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. I saw one in a Greek and Roman mythology comic when I was in elementary school. It looked awesome—all huge muscles and everything.”

hunks.baseline: A Minotaur was among the stronger monsters in the B-rank category. It had been roughly five hundred light-years away from me, an eternal F-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: Minotaurs were among the stronger B-rank monsters. For someone like me, who had spent years stuck at F-rank, they might as well have been five hundred light-years away.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “That’s all right. You can see one now.”
hunks.sol: “That’s all right. This is your chance to see one.”

hunks.baseline: *Is a Gate a zoo? Are we going there just to sightsee?*
hunks.sol: *Is a Gate a zoo? Are we just going there to look?*

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi handed me a tablet, answering as breezily as if this had nothing to do with him.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi answered breezily, as if this had nothing to do with him, and handed me a tablet.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a next-generation tablet powered by a C-rank Magic Gem. With its elegant design and outstanding performance, it’s sold exclusively to a select number of VIPs……”
hunks.sol: “It’s a next-generation tablet powered by a C-rank Magic Gem. With its elegant design and outstanding performance, it’s available exclusively to a select number of VIPs……”

hunks.baseline: “Just give me the conclusion.”
hunks.sol: “Just give me the point.”

hunks.baseline: “I put some raid footage on it. Watch.”
hunks.sol: “I loaded some raid footage onto it. Watch.”

hunks.baseline: He could’ve just said that from the start. Im Kkeokjeong and I put our heads together and watched the video stored on the tablet.
hunks.sol: He could’ve said that from the start. Im Kkeokjeong and I put our heads together and watched the video stored on the tablet.

hunks.baseline: “All right, stay calm. Stay calm. Especially the tanks! Keep those shields up. If they break through, everyone here is dead. Of course, I’ll kill you before that happens.”
hunks.sol: “All right, stay calm. Stay calm. Especially the tanks! Keep those shields up. If they break through, everyone here is dead. Of course, I’ll kill you myself before that happens.”

hunks.baseline: Around fifteen Hunters formed an orderly formation at the raid leader’s command. Every one of them was visibly tense.
hunks.sol: Around fifteen Hunters swiftly formed an orderly formation at the raid leader’s command. Every one of them was visibly tense.

hunks.baseline: *Tanks, melee and ranged damage dealers. There’s a mage and even a healer.*
hunks.sol: *Four tanks, melee and ranged damage dealers. They’ve even got a mage and a healer.*

hunks.baseline: Their teamwork seemed decent, and so did the team composition.
hunks.sol: Their teamwork seemed solid, and the team composition wasn’t bad either.

hunks.baseline: A B-rank monster, something I had only ever seen in monster encyclopedias, appeared on the screen.
hunks.sol: A B-rank monster I had only ever seen in monster encyclopedias appeared on the screen.

hunks.baseline: Their bellowing echoed through the cave. Rock dust shook loose and fell in little showers as the battle began.
hunks.sol: Their bellows echoed through the cave. Rock dust shook loose and rained down as the battle began.

hunks.baseline: The raid leader screamed himself hoarse. At the same time, around twenty arrows infused with mana struck the head of the lead Minotaur.
hunks.sol: The raid leader screamed himself hoarse. At the same moment, around twenty mana-infused arrows struck the lead Minotaur in the head.

hunks.baseline: Focusing fire on one target instead of using a wide-area attack had been a good choice. Aiming precisely for its head had been especially effective.
hunks.sol: Focusing fire on a single target instead of using a wide-area attack was a good decision. Aiming precisely for its head had been especially effective.

hunks.baseline: The Minotaur clawed at its own face in agony. The finishing blow came from the companions following behind it.
hunks.sol: The Minotaur clawed at its face in agony, only for the ones behind it to deliver the finishing blow.

hunks.baseline: They used the dead Minotaur’s corpse as a shield and charged straight ahead. Arrows and magic rained down, but they only shredded the corpse. The Minotaurs hiding behind it were unharmed.
hunks.sol: Using the dead Minotaur’s corpse as a shield, they charged straight ahead. Arrows and magic rained down, but only shredded the corpse. The Minotaurs sheltering behind it remained unharmed.

hunks.baseline: They knew how to use their heads. They were at least as intelligent as goblins, while being dozens of times stronger.
hunks.sol: They knew how to use their heads. They were at least as intelligent as goblins and dozens of times stronger.

hunks.baseline: Which made them even more dangerous.
hunks.sol: That made them all the more dangerous.

hunks.baseline: At the team leader’s shout, the veins stood out on the tanks’ arms and necks. Their shields, covered in hazy mana, blocked the iron clubs carrying tremendous force.
hunks.sol: At the team leader’s shout, veins bulged on the tanks’ arms and necks. Their shields, wreathed in hazy mana, blocked the iron clubs swinging with tremendous force.

hunks.baseline: A small shadow suddenly dropped from the air between them. A Hunter from the stealth category drove a blackened dagger into another Minotaur’s eye before disappearing.
hunks.sol: A small shadow suddenly dropped out of the air between them. A stealth-type Hunter drove a blackened dagger into another Minotaur’s eye, then vanished.

hunks.baseline: B-rank monsters weren’t invincible. With the support of the other melee damage dealers, archers, and mage, two more Minotaurs fell in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: B-rank monsters weren’t invincible. With support from the other melee damage dealers, archers, and mage, two more Minotaurs fell in the blink of an eye.

hunks.baseline: Screams and roars filled the cave. Through the clouds of dust, I could see the cow-headed monsters tearing through the formation and swinging their iron clubs.
hunks.sol: Screams and roars filled the cave. Through the billowing dust, I could see the cow-headed monsters tearing through the formation and swinging their iron clubs.

hunks.baseline: “Tanks, damage dealers! Ranged, don’t hold back your mana—pour it all in! Ranged, open up some distance!”
hunks.sol: “Tanks, damage dealers! Ranged, don’t hold back your mana—pour it all in! Ranged, fall back!”

hunks.baseline: The video continued for about ten minutes before cutting off. The battle hadn’t ended yet. The camera had simply been smashed by an iron club.
hunks.sol: The video continued for around ten minutes before cutting out. The battle wasn’t over. The camera had simply been smashed by an iron club.

hunks.baseline: As the Minotaur’s roar rang out, the screen filled with static and faded to black and white. Im Kkeokjeong swallowed hard.
hunks.sol: The image dissolved into black-and-white static beneath the Minotaur’s roar. Im Kkeokjeong swallowed hard.

hunks.baseline: I handed the tablet back to Team Leader Choi and asked,
hunks.sol: I handed the tablet back to Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: “It was footage of the Bucheon Terminal Guild’s raid last week.”
hunks.sol: “Footage from the Bucheon Terminal Guild’s raid last week.”

hunks.baseline: *Whoever named that Guild had some incredible naming sense.*
hunks.sol: *Whoever named that Guild had one hell of a sense for names.*

hunks.baseline: Not that I had any room to talk, considering I belonged to the Peace Guild, but at least our name was better than Bucheon Terminal Guild.
hunks.sol: Not that I had much room to talk as a member of the Peace Guild, but at least our name was better than Bucheon Terminal Guild.

hunks.baseline: “What was the result?”
hunks.sol: “What happened?”

hunks.baseline: People dying during raids wasn’t particularly rare. Being a Hunter meant repeatedly drawing close to death, then running away from it.
hunks.sol: Deaths during raids weren’t particularly rare. Being a Hunter meant repeatedly drawing close to death, then escaping it.

hunks.baseline: That was all I could say. I pulled out my smartphone and searched for it. Several related articles appeared.
hunks.sol: That was all I could manage. I pulled out my smartphone and searched for the incident. Several related articles appeared.

hunks.baseline:
> **A Bucheon Guild: The Sacrifice Brought on by a Reckless Raid**
>
> On the sixteenth, C-rank Hunters identified as Mr. Lee and Mr. Park died in the B-rank Gate *The Minotaur’s Labyrinth*. The Hunter Association authorities……
hunks.sol:
> **Bucheon Guild’s Reckless Raid Ends in Tragedy**
>
> On the sixteenth, C-rank Hunters identified as Mr. Lee and Mr. Park died in the B-rank Gate *The Minotaur’s Labyrinth*. Hunter Association officials……

hunks.baseline: So the people who died had been C-rank Hunters. That made sense. A small-to-medium Guild like that couldn’t possibly have a talent pool large enough to fill a raid team of fifteen B-rank Hunters.
hunks.sol: So the Hunters who died had been C-rank. That made sense. A small-to-medium Guild like that couldn’t possibly have enough talent to fill a fifteen-person raid team entirely with B-rank Hunters.
[^2]: Makgeolli is a traditional Korean rice wine with a milky appearance and a mildly sweet, tangy flavor.
